_doc: Input of make_done_exclusions.py: the short list of MEMOS #70 (3), designs that may stay out of the DoD-5 band (exact or at most 15 % over), each with its per-array cause, the Vitis evidence and why it is out of scope. 'status' says whether Peter has accepted the entry; 'proposed' entries come from a prove report and wait for him.

entries.cause: conv1d_2 / conv1d_3 / conv1d_4: Vitis does not flatten the parent loop with its auto-pipelined child ([HLS 200-960] '... either the parent loop or sub loop is do-while loop'), so the child runs alone at II 1 and the temp_* weights are RAM_1WNR with 4 copies; hls-est flattens, gets II 10 and RAM_2P (-156); the remaining -3 is a register-sized array
entries.vitis_evidence: VITIS_NOTES N64: 11 kernels w9r8p_ie_acc / w9r8p_dw_* / w9r8p_fl_pre*; the non-flattened parents are already in rotated (do-while) form in db/a.o.1.ll
entries.why_out_of_scope: the source shape that makes Vitis's front end rotate the parent loop is not identified (neither the if, the invariant loads nor the accumulation chain decides it); without it the refusal cannot be modelled without branching on the design

entries.cause: -56 over several buffers (*_buffers row views, OPEN_ISSUES O84 (d)); not attributed to a mechanism per array
entries.vitis_evidence: OPEN_ISSUES O90 class 'unexplained' (K15); semantics: the candidate also mismatches the native build (OPEN_ISSUES O44-like, check_semantics 'mismatch')
entries.why_out_of_scope: unexplained per array; the cgeist output itself is not bit-exact against the native build, so the estimate is of a different program

entries.cause: -56: the twiddle / stage buffers of the unroll-factor-8 butterflies (OPEN_ISSUES O79)
entries.vitis_evidence: OPEN_ISSUES O79: UF8 and UF2 differ from UF1 / UF4 / UF16 / UF32 (in band) in a way no kernel has reproduced
